decisions.inventory: 1022 actual rows across11 intact collector families: Base275, Gold275, Silver275, Uncirculated110, Draft Day10, Fabric17, Flashback Autographs8, Flashback Jerseys11, Signs19, Red Ink20, Checklists2. Regular paper Bowman only; separate Chrome, Best and cross-product Team Topps Legends excluded. Generic redemption rights are not player cards.
decisions.rookies: 165 true base RCs111-275, fully matched against two-page rookie index and independent165RC flags. No rookie suffixes inferred on parallels or autograph/relic inserts. James Allen#49 veteran RB and #261 Saints rookie LB are different subjects.
decisions.identity: Original Edward Reed#138 is displayed as Ed Reed; preserve printed name on base metadata. Correct Jeremy Allen Gold/Silver#197 source Miami to Minnesota, corroborated by original base front/back and independent Silver catalogues.
decisions.numbering: Use actual primary numbers; independent Draft Day H-/J- shorthand maps to original DDH-/DDJ- confirmed by Carr back. Retain catalogue SF-DG1 for Red Ink Daniel Graham; physical suffix needs image QA. Uncirculated partial parallel uses110 actual noncontiguous numbers, not assumed range.
decisions.serials: Gold /50 and Silver /250. Red Ink12 explicit /50 source tags retained; eight others lack explicit serial metadata, so do not manufacture stamps. Uncirculated reported290 production is not asserted as physical serial /290; source attributes conflict and encased originals need QA.
decisions.materials: Draft-day apparel is event worn, not game used; Fabric jerseys are game worn at Senior Bowl; Flashback jerseys are player worn. Certified signatures separate from facsimile Bowman base design.
decisions.packConfiguration: Hobby24x10, corroborated dealer descriptions. HTA10x35 differs. Combined parallel/autograph/relic odds are not individual family rates. Preserve historical tier evidence and leave per-family odds null pending verified aggregates; no guessed ratios.
decisions.verificationLimit: All numbers/names/teams/subsets/RCs checked at catalogue level, including full independent insert/Uncirculated rosters and selected originals. Not physical verification of every card. Graham suffix, eight Red Ink serial attributes, Uncirculated physical serial status and full pack collation remain QA items.
decisions.release: Unreleased Admin draft for pricing and image harvesting only. No production database access, release or deployment; reruns preserve prices/images/release state.
